## 0b. Runaway thinking

A chain is **runaway** when at least one of its 30 iterations was a
successful call that returned an empty assistant message after a
full-length generation (the whole token budget went to reasoning).
Once a chain goes runaway it never recovers: the same input is re-fed at
the next iteration. Empty records with `elapsed_seconds == 0` are
**padding** appended by the rerun harness after two consecutive empties;
they mark an already-runaway chain and are never counted as separate
events. **Clean** chains have no empty iteration at all; **incomplete**
chains have fewer than 30 successful scored iterations
(or do not end on a success). The same rule is applied to every model,
0.8B included.
